A document review service has a two-second interactive SLA and a slower workflow that achieves higher quality on ambiguous cases. A representative evaluation shows most requests are simple and only a small minority need deeper review. Which design best preserves the SLA while providing a path for difficult cases?
B
Put every request through the slowest workflow
This ignores the measured latency constraint for the majority of requests.
Route validated simple cases through the fast path and handle ambiguous cases through an explicitly asynchronous review path
The design separates service expectations using measured task complexity and makes slower handling explicit.
Promise the slow workflow will always finish within two seconds
The observation contradicts that promise.
Remove quality checks from the slow path
This sacrifices the purpose of the deeper review.

C

Repeat both policies several times
